boundaries: Verify the actual operator host and authorized connection before server work. Local paths and loopback addresses identify that host; public HTTPS access does not prove remote shell access.

SATCOM mission control remains under development. Direct model prompts are the primary workflow. GUI development for news, activity and town sites is as important as content. Headless-only constraints apply to the PDF-to-WordPress pipeline, not publication GUI development.
Work directly; do not delegate or spawn other agents.
Partners in the Community is the primary advertising and sponsorship platform. Directory listings are not verified paying sponsors or outreach permission.
The MCP service supplies public context only. It cannot deploy, retrieve secrets, access subscriber records, send messages or operate telephony.
A health response proves this context service is responding, not that Ace, Hermes, a payment provider or publishing pipeline is connected.
conews.press/codex is a different route from satcom.conews.press/codex. Its recorded September 7 failure has not been rechecked by this priorities refresh.
Package prices and sales targets in the 2026 plan are proposals until approved. Do not publish them as offers or actual results.

operatorPolicy.rule: Work directly. Stop or confirm the prior executor has ended before switching. A timeout alone does not prove a job stopped. Carry one task packet and its completed work forward; do not restart the entire task. The operator is on a remote laptop without a server connection; verify the actual host before server work.
